scheme_name: Agriculture And Processed Foods Export Promotion Scheme Of APEDA For The 15th Finance Commission Cycle (2021-22 To 2025-26)
other_conditions: Must be an APEDA registered exporter or an eligible organization as listed in the beneficiaries section
Application must be for APEDA scheduled products only
Date of online application is considered the receipt date; expenditures incurred before this date are not eligible
Expenditures incurred after application but before issuance of In‑Principle Approval are subject to APEDA’s final decision
Exporters from North‑Eastern states, Himalayan/land‑locked states, Island UTs, SC/ST and women beneficiaries are eligible for up to 75% assistance (financial ceiling unchanged)
SC/ST eligibility requires at least 51% shareholding by SC/ST persons for the stipulated period
Women entrepreneur eligibility requires the entity to exist for at least one year and all partners/directors/promoters to be women
For organic products, the unit must have processing scope under NPOP requirements
Application must be accompanied by self‑certified documents and submitted within 30 days of online application
Quotations/proforma invoices/bills must be obtained from a minimum of three OEMs or their authorized distributors; assistance calculated on the lowest quoted rate
Feasibility study quotations must be from consulting firms with at least five years of relevant experience
Quotations must clearly show address, GSTN, TIN, PAN, product description, validity date, and item‑wise cost
Civil work assistance is limited to technical civil work and requires a cost estimate certified by a Chartered Engineer or Civil Architect
Technical civil work component cannot exceed 25% of the total eligible assistance for the application
Training program schedule/calendar or prospectus must be submitted with the application
Quarterly export performance data must be uploaded on the APEDA website even if exports are nil
In‑principle approval is required for all scheme components except lab testing charges
Applicants must hold valid registration/license with FSSAI or other relevant regulatory authorities
Beneficiary units receiving assistance cannot be sold within five years of disbursement
Applicants must declare that no financial assistance has been received from any other state/central agency
Eligibility category noted in source: SC/ST
Eligibility category noted in source: Women
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to 50% of project cost (up to ₹5‑20 lakh per activity) with higher percentages (up to 75%) for SC/ST, women, and exporters from designated regions.
documents_required: Quotation/proforma invoice/bill from at least three OEMs
Cost estimate certified by a Chartered Engineer or Civil Architect
Declaration stating no other financial assistance received
